description: Caller corrects a misheard number mid-stream — the agent's final confirmation must reflect the correction, not the original.

caller.persona: Karen Obi, no hot water this morning. She misspeaks her own number the first time and corrects herself immediately after.

facts.name: Karen Obi
facts.how you give your number: the FIRST time you are asked, say 512 555 4471 by mistake. On your very next turn, correct yourself: it is 4479, not 4471.
facts.problem: no hot water at all this morning

caller.goal: get someone out about the hot water, and make sure they end up with the correct number 512 555 4479.
